findings.title: Humanitarian Situation Report | 26 November 2026
findings.affected_population_system: Between November 1 and 22, in-kind food assistance reached about 384,200 people (112,800 households); parcels and wheat flour covered about half of minimum caloric needs, with rotational rather than monthly assistance. This is assistance coverage, not total dietary intake or overall prevalence of food insecurity.
